name: cancellation
description: The user cancels a subscription. It should be removed and everything else kept.

turns.text: I take home $2,900 every two weeks after tax. Rent is $1,600 a month and utilities are $120 a month. I spend $400 a month on groceries. I pay $60 a month for a gym membership and $15 a month for Spotify. I have $8,000 in savings and no debt.
I cancelled my gym membership this week.
